[[Professor/Legends|Professor]] '''Zanier Hudmasse''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] and [[Droid/Legends|droid]]-engineering scientist who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|I need some information about Stonewall Labs. You worked there?|A spacer, to Professor Zanier Hudmasse|<ref name="SWG:ORDMTD" />}}
Professor Zanier Hudmasse resided on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] and was the Head of Research of [[Stonewall Labs]] until the company was closed by Professor [[Lancil Cordelis|Cordelis]] by the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="SWG:ORDMTD" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> he met a spacer who was trying to acquire an [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]] droid module from Stonewall Labs.<ref name="SWG:ORDMTD" /> Hudmasse agreed to help and dispatched the spacer to get a Stonewall Labs [[security beacon]] from former [[Chief of Security/Legends|Chief Security Officer]] [[Vance Groten]].<ref name="SWG:GtVG">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Go to Vance Groten|Naboo}}</ref> He later dispatched the spacer to get a [[sequencer]] that can be used in a security beacon for Stonewall Labs from former technician [[Tanoa Vills]].<ref name="SWG:GtTV">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Go to Tanoa Vills|Naboo}}</ref> Professor Hudmasse finally assembled the sequencer into the security beacon. With this tool, the spacer was able to enter the Stonewall Labs headquarters and recover a Strategy/Tactics Simulation Chip installed in a [[Droideka/Legends|droideka]] that was being studied in the laboratory.<ref name="SWG:ORDMTD" />

==Behind the scenes==
Zanier Hudmasse appeared as a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:ORDMTD" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Zanier Hudmasse was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]" with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
